With only 3 validation windows, moderate ranking stability, and correlated error groups, the robust trimmed mean over the 7 most consistent models is well-matched to this trend-dominated series. action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.99) with weak seasonality and moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.44). The trimmed_mean over the 7 most consistently-ranked models (pool2) is a robust combination that avoids overfitting to 3 noisy validation windows while still leveraging the top-performing wavelet-RF models. Correlated error groups (8 groups, only 2 independent) mean adding more models adds little diversity. The leader is a seed baseline and the runner-up margin is statistically indistinguishable, confirming no tested strategy offers a real improvement.
